blocks.task_summary: Find the radius of the base of the cone using trigonometry given vertical height 20 m, distance 5 m, eye level 1.8 m, and angle of elevation 58°.
method_path: Set up equation using tan 58° = (20 - 1.8) / (5 + r)
Solve for r to get r = 18.2 / tan 58° - 5 ≈ 6.37 m
accepted_alternatives: Using sine rule: (5 + r) / sin 32° = 18.2 / sin 58°

evidence.basis: attempt to use trigonometry to find the radius (M1); 18.2 / tan58 = 5 + r OR (5 + r) / sin32 = 18.2 / sin58 (A1); r = 6.37 (A1)

blocks.task_summary: Find the volume of the monument (right cone) using the radius from part (a) and height 20 m.
method_path: Substitute r from part (a) and h = 20 into V = (1/3)π r^2 h
Compute and round to 3 significant figures (or as appropriate) to get 851 m³

evidence.basis: attempt to substitute h=20 and their radius into correct volume of cone formula (M1); V = π (6.37...)^2 * 20 / 3 = 850.54... → 851 m³ (A1); Note: Accept 849.84... (850) from r=6.37
